notes.title: Unveil the Magic of Elemental Novice! 🌟
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PfiVHOpqcAE;full][/previewyoutube]✨ Exciting News! ✨
I’m thrilled to announce my passion project, Elemental Novice, is live on Kickstarter! 🎮
Elemental Novice is an indie RPG inspired by classics like Titan Quest, Divinity: Original Sin 2, and Vampire Survivors. It’s a dreamworld adventure where players take on the role of a young mage learning to control elemental forces. But when the dream becomes a trap, the stakes get real—and it’s up to you to solve the mystery and master your powers!
🌟 Game Highlights:
 ✅ Unique spellcasting system—no cooldowns, but watch out for elemental consequences!
 ✅ Diverse challenges: puzzles, survival arenas, and stunning environments like deserts, forests, cemeteries, and more.
 ✅ A deep RPG experience featuring NPC interactions, elemental puzzles, and intense combat arenas.
I’ve been developing this game solo, with occasional help from friends. Now, I’m asking for your support to make this dream come true. With additional resources, I can expand the story, add more gameplay features, and take Elemental Novice to the next level! 🚀
🔗 Check it out here:
Kickstarter: https://lnkd.in/deCJCRRC

Steam Early Access: https://lnkd.in/dYBjbshU 
Community: https://lnkd.in/diK2au3U

I’d love to hear your thoughts and see you join this journey with me. Whether you support the Kickstarter, wishlist on Steam, or simply share this post, every bit helps!
Let’s bring Elemental Novice to life and make magic together! ✨

notes.title: Elemental novice New patch 0.11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm glad to share a new update. There will be more in the future, but for now have at this. Added: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982376/94b68b5cced6b6de8707b69e53be0b0f42edbd05.png[/img]

I was wondering if people know what to do so some hints have been added.
If you thought that the survival mode was too complicated, you may take a shovel now and dig graves to reduce the amount of zombies during the night.
If you need advice or pointers - the new character Hana (not playable) is here for you.
Added a jump animation for jumping in place.
Added casting with left mouse button and the possibility to change this in options (left mouse button is the new default).
Added a new talent that allows you to finish concentration immediately (you still need to think about the consequences).
Various other bug fixes.

Hope you enjoy the update! Until next time.
